However, mounting #DRAM directly onto high-power logic introduces severe thermal and yield challenges. Crucially, Intel must avoid past proprietary memory failures like Optane by securing broad ecosystem standardization, balancing internal manufacturing against partner supply chains, and proving commercial viability against existing solutions.
